content.description: Notebook content as a ProseMirror JSON document structure.

deleted.description: Whether the notebook has been soft-deleted.

text_content.description: Plain text representation of the notebook content for search.

variables.description: Notebook-level variables, in display order. A SQL cell reads one as a `{name}` placeholder and a Python cell as a global. Names must be unique.

items.description: One notebook-level variable. Shared by the notebook's own `variables` field and a run body.

name.description: Identifier the cell reads: `{name}` in a SQL cell, a plain global in a Python cell.

type.description: How to coerce the value: 'string', 'number', 'boolean', or 'date'. Unknown types read as 'string'.

value.description: The variable's current value. A 'date' is an absolute date or datetime in ISO 8601 form ('2025-01-31', '2025-01-31T09:00:00Z'); relative expressions such as '-7d' are rejected.

version.description: Version number for optimistic concurrency control. Must match the current version when updating content.
